newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gencor turns down role in Brazil's CVRD.
newsitem.headline: Gencor turns down role in Brazil's CVRD.

text.p: South Africa's Gencor Ltd GMFJ.J said on Friday it would not pursue a bid for the mining assets of Brazil's state-run Companhia Vale do Rio Doce (CVRD).

"The executive committee has concluded that the opportunity to take a leading role in the management of CVRD... would not contribute sufficiently to Gencor's global strategy," Gencor said in a statement.
The mining giant added the deal would also not fit its commitment to deliver rapid growth in value to its shareholders.
"Gencor has therefore decided not to pursue such a major role in CVRD's privatisation," the company said.
Brazilian officials plan an initial sell-off of a 40-45 percent controlling stake in CVRD. Gencor said in December that it was considering a bid for the assets of the Brazilian mining operation.
